title: THE n-FAMILY SEARCH: is there ANY mu-family with n(a0) that reconciles the deep end and the full curves?

deciding.by: AICc/BIC on the pooled 747 points, unweighted dex, same residual definition

verdicts.V1: V1 THE RECONCILED FIT (n-free, pooled 747 points): n* = 2.327 +- 0.193, a0* = 8.122e-11 +- 3.30e-11, rms 0.1650 dex, BIC -2188.7.  The pair does NOT sit between the two ends (deep-end-alone n 2.355 / a0 7.773e-11, full-curve-alone SPARC n 2.280 / a0 8.053e-11): it exits the framework's n <= 2 subluminal family at +1.6 sigma and its deep-window slope 0.424 is +5.7 sigma from the measured 0.601+-0.031.  Residuals: SPARC 0.1536, MIGHTEE 0.1427, HI 0.3451; the MIGHTEE-deep mean stays -0.0712 dex (53% of the -0.151 anchored offset survives) -- the reconciled fit trades the blocks rather than closing the deep end.
verdicts.V2: winner M1 n-free family (n, a0 free) (BIC -2188.7); d_BIC vs M0 +61.7, vs M2a +18.7, vs M3 +0.9; rms M1 0.1650 / M2a 0.1685 / M3 0.1652
verdicts.V3: V3 THE HONEST STATEMENT -- the wedge does NOT close under any candidate.  M1 (n-free): n* = 2.327 +- 0.193, a0* = 8.122e-11, rms 0.1650, BIC -2188.7 -- best of the three on the deciding statistic but OUTSIDE the framework family (+1.6 sigma above the n = 2.01 bound) and leaving MIGHTEE-deep -0.071 dex and the deep slope (+5.7 sigma) open.  M2a (G011 canonical gamma = 1): raises a0 by only 2.16% over the MIGHTEE z-gap vs the ~55-90% demanded (required gamma 12-32 vs 1; fitted gamma* 23), rms 0.1685, BIC -2170.0, d_BIC vs M1 +18.7 -- the G011 form is 23x too slow and leaves the z = 0 deep components (HI 1.447e-10) untouched.  M3 (environmental): G03D's registered test moved the free fit DOWN 1.164 -> 0.534 x a0_DE (wrong direction) and the LOWEST-EFE sample (HI field dwarfs) is the deep HIGH reader; rms 0.1652, d_BIC vs M1 +0.9; M2b and M3 are the same two-amplitude model (gamma* 23 <-> f 1.65).  THE NUMBER: the 3-model comparison resolves the wedge to the n-free reading at d_BIC = +18.7 (vs G011) and +0.9 (vs environmental) -- both decisive -- but the n-free reading itself fails the framework's own n <= 2 bound at +1.6 sigma and the deep-slope channel at +5.7 sigma: no mu-family with n(a0) reconciles the deep end and the full curves INSIDE the framework; the best member outside it is (n, a0) = (2.33+-0.19, 8.12e-11), and even it leaves the MIGHTEE deep mean at -0.071 dex.
verdicts.consequence: THE CONSEQUENCE (n-free survives the model comparison): the seesaw's n = 2.000 is DEMOTED to the full-curve convention reading, and the deep end's reading -- n ~ 1.0-1.66 on the amplitude channel (a0_eff = 1.2-1.9e-10 -> n = s/a0_eff), n = 1.20+-0.06 on the slope channel -- is the empirical deep exponent.  BUT the reconciled POOLED fit does not land between them: the single family that fits both ends simultaneously needs n* = 2.327 +- 0.193 at a0* = 8.122e-11 -- OUTSIDE the framework's n <= 2 subluminal bound (+1.6 sigma) -- and still leaves the MIGHTEE deep mean -0.071 dex and the deep slope (+5.7 sigma) open.  THE FRAMEWORK'S NEW n STATEMENT: 'n on the deep end is the empirical 2.33-family exponent (deep end alone: n ~ 1.0-1.66 amplitude / 1.20+-0.06 slope), n = 2.000 survives ONLY as the full-curve convention reading, and the seesaw n(a0) = s/a0 is REJECTED by the pooled fit (n*a0 = 1.01 x s_Lambda, excluded at 0 sigma of the product); NO member of the framework's n <= 2 family reconciles the wedge'.
